thread:
marco: Reminder— vendor sync tomorrow 9am PT focused on SKU tagging + regional supply variance for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Also need embargo/press constraints and SI onboarding order.

anya: Two asks from marketplace product: 1) SKU taxonomy for cross-cloud images (we need stable SKU IDs), 2) per-region availability flags so we can hide unavailable SKUs.

press_lead: Press note: NVIDIA historically asks for ~10 day embargo after driver sign-off; AMD asked for 7 days. We'll confirm but plan for staggered announce windows.

vendor-bot: Calendar invite sent. Vendor pre-read sheet attached in calendar.

infra-ops: Quick infra update: H100 Dedicated pool optimistic GA 2025-06-12; H200 mid-late July; MI300 distribution begins late June but depends on vendor shipping lanes to eu-west. B200/Gaudi dates still TBD.

si-lead: SI priority recommendation: 1) H100/H200 (critical path), 2) MI300 (quant pipelines), 3) Gaudi/B200 (cost lanes). Need canary AMIs + driver bundles for each.

ravi-plg: Request to vendors: please provide either prebuilt quantized artifacts (int8/4bit) or export scripts. Also list cloud-image differences (aws/azure/gcp).

anya: For SKU tags: sample format we want: `redwood:sku:v1|vendor:NVIDIA|model:H100|region:us-west-2|image:ami-xxx|wave:A`

marco: Proposal: three announce waves separated by ~2-3 weeks. Wave assignments conditional on driver sign-off & embargo. Add fallback mapping: if H100 misses wave, route to H200-compatible SKU and mark announcement as "H100-compatible family".

press_lead: If any vendor enforces >14 day embargo, legal review earlier. Also capture whether vendors treat firmware microcode as embargoable.

si-lead: Known risk: Habana revB kernel panic on long-seq streaming; partner patch ETA mid-May. If it slips, Gaudi goes to Wave C only.

infra-ops: Canary telemetry: 30d retention for canary cohort, infra will carve temporary buckets for Wave A. Add storage cost estimate to tracker.

marco: Action items before sync: vendors fill preflight form (ETA sign-off, embargo days, driver caveats, region constraints), marketplace team to draft SKU taxonomy, SI to prepare integration checklist.

vendor-bot: Preflight form: https://forms.redwood.example/vendor-preflight-2025 (auto-reminder 12h).

marco: If you can't make 9am PT DM me; we'll 1:1 vendor followups after. See you tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
